purpose: Gate stronger backbones after T9d-v5 failed to generalize. Public results motivate candidates but never serve as training or selection rows. The ladder verifies license, immutable revision, tokenizer/model compatibility, MPS memory, DecisionModel forward, LoRA injection, zero-adapter parity and teardown before any training amendment.

internal.finding: 0.6B v5 heldout_v2 mean accuracy 0.331; choice degrades from 0.367 at k=4 to 0.042 at k=12; score-5 is 0.062. Capacity, candidate-set mismatch and semantic shift remain competing hypotheses.

semif.reported_owned_workload: Qwen3-0.6B 0.440, MiniCPM5-2B 0.686, Qwen3.5-4B 0.813 authored balanced accuracy
semif.boundary: external project evidence only; no rows, outputs or TypeSafe records may enter NanoJev training, calibration or selection

jevbench.reported_method_signal: Qwen3.5-4B typed-decision systems are near the leading group; one implementation changed from 72% to 21% under yes/no order reversal
jevbench.boundary: public benchmark remains quarantined; per-task rows and failures are not read for this ladder

laya_mlx.reported_method_signal: 421M bidirectional typed encoder demonstrates low-latency Apple-Silicon packaging and strict port parity
laya_mlx.boundary: runtime/application reference only; no weights, outputs or benchmark rows imported

candidates.reason: lowest-risk capacity step; direct AutoModel and existing LoRA target names are expected to work

candidates.known_blocker: top-level config has no hidden_size; current DecisionModel requires a text-language-backbone adapter and parity tests before real-weight MPS probing

probe_gates: exact revision and Apache-2.0 metadata recorded
tokenizer and model load without trust_remote_code
DecisionModel forward returns finite logits on an owned synthetic fixture
LoRA injection wraps expected projection modules
zero-initialized adapter changes logits by at most 1e-5 with dropout disabled
MPS load and synchronized forward stay within declared memory budget
no heldout, JevBench, SemIf or provider rows are used

promotion.to_single_seed_training: all compatibility gates pass and a fresh owner-visible training amendment freezes budget and owned evaluation gates
promotion.to_three_seed_training: single seed improves dev mechanics and independently authored owned diagnostic gates without protected-error regression
promotion.to_jevbench: never from this ladder; J-E1 internal candidate freeze remains required
